<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex45042024-08-2914-22-287" status="unreviewed">gle chon gyi chos zhes brjod pa 'khrul gzhi yod la | phyos zhes brjod na bskas ming du 'gro bas 2 ka ltar mi rjod phod gyi chos zhes dang ming gis rjod na go bde mod khar zan
            <lb n="N007"/>'jug pa la lab pa bskyor ci dogs snyam na | dngos ming de ltar rjod na lrub pa ci yang med mod kyi don kyang shed chon gyi <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3892">chos rje</rs>s 'gro ldog pa zhes tshul 3 brjod pa yige mnyaM pas rjer mi bde ba dang | phyogs 'thong pod medang || zhes bya ba lasog pa'i tshog le'ur byas pa mi 'grib pas mkhas
            <lb n="N008"/>pa rnams kyis bad pa mtshad yang star kyi de 'jug thos pa bzhugs kyi don go na stod pang nas pa yon pa yang ba'i yang hyir zhes dang gyi thin pa la zhus kyis den togs pang nyes pa brgyad pa ma yin mnyam pas bsgus kyang pa yong du spangs pa yino | des na kyi skyed ni rtog kyang ba pa dang nas
        <lb n="73b8"/>…<rs type="work">gtan tshigs thigs pa</rs> las : * kyis don go yang nye bar b* pa * yi ge mnyam pas bsgrub dka' ba yongs su spangs pa yin no |</seg></TEI>
